#====================================================================================================
# START - Testing Protocol - DO NOT EDIT OR REMOVE THIS SECTION
#====================================================================================================

# THIS SECTION CONTAINS CRITICAL TESTING INSTRUCTIONS FOR BOTH AGENTS
# BOTH MAIN_AGENT AND TESTING_AGENT MUST PRESERVE THIS ENTIRE BLOCK

# Communication Protocol:
# If the `testing_agent` is available, main agent should delegate all testing tasks to it.
#
# You have access to a file called `test_result.md`. This file contains the complete testing state
# and history, and is the primary means of communication between main and the testing agent.
#
# Main and testing agents must follow this exact format to maintain testing data. 
# The testing data must be entered in yaml format Below is the data structure:
# 
## user_problem_statement: {problem_statement}
## backend:
##   - task: "Task name"
##     implemented: true
##     working: true  # or false or "NA"
##     file: "file_path.py"
##     stuck_count: 0
##     priority: "high"  # or "medium" or "low"
##     needs_retesting: false
##     status_history:
##         -working: true  # or false or "NA"
##         -agent: "main"  # or "testing" or "user"
##         -comment: "Detailed comment about status"
##
## frontend:
##   - task: "Task name"
##     implemented: true
##     working: true  # or false or "NA"
##     file: "file_path.js"
##     stuck_count: 0
##     priority: "high"  # or "medium" or "low"
##     needs_retesting: false
##     status_history:
##         -working: true  # or false or "NA"
##         -agent: "main"  # or "testing" or "user"
##         -comment: "Detailed comment about status"
##
## metadata:
##   created_by: "main_agent"
##   version: "1.0"
##   test_sequence: 0
##   run_ui: false
##
## test_plan:
##   current_focus:
##     - "Task name 1"
##     - "Task name 2"
##   stuck_tasks:
##     - "Task name with persistent issues"
##   test_all: false
##   test_priority: "high_first"  # or "sequential" or "stuck_first"
##
## agent_communication:
##     -agent: "main"  # or "testing" or "user"
##     -message: "Communication message between agents"

# Protocol Guidelines for Main agent
#
# 1. Update Test Result File Before Testing:
#    - Main agent must always update the `test_result.md` file before calling the testing agent
#    - Add implementation details to the status_history
#    - Set `needs_retesting` to true for tasks that need testing
#    - Update the `test_plan` section to guide testing priorities
#    - Add a message to `agent_communication` explaining what you've done
#
# 2. Incorporate User Feedback:
#    - When a user provides feedback that something is or isn't working, add this information to the relevant task's status_history
#    - Update the working status based on user feedback
#    - If a user reports an issue with a task that was marked as working, increment the stuck_count
#    - Whenever user reports issue in the app, if we have testing agent and task_result.md file so find the appropriate task for that and append in status_history of that task to contain the user concern and problem as well 
#
# 3. Track Stuck Tasks:
#    - Monitor which tasks have high stuck_count values or where you are fixing same issue again and again, analyze that when you read task_result.md
#    - For persistent issues, use websearch tool to find solutions
#    - Pay special attention to tasks in the stuck_tasks list
#    - When you fix an issue with a stuck task, don't reset the stuck_count until the testing agent confirms it's working
#
# 4. Provide Context to Testing Agent:
#    - When calling the testing agent, provide clear instructions about:
#      - Which tasks need testing (reference the test_plan)
#      - Any authentication details or configuration needed
#      - Specific test scenarios to focus on
#      - Any known issues or edge cases to verify
#
# 5. Call the testing agent with specific instructions referring to test_result.md
#
# IMPORTANT: Main agent must ALWAYS update test_result.md BEFORE calling the testing agent, as it relies on this file to understand what to test next.

#====================================================================================================
# END - Testing Protocol - DO NOT EDIT OR REMOVE THIS SECTION
#====================================================================================================

# Testing Data - Main Agent and testing sub agent both should log testing data below this section
#====================================================================================================

##           comment: "✅✅✅ WARM PIPELINE BUG FIX VERIFIED (2026-07-27 20:21) ✅✅✅: Comprehensive end-to-end testing confirms the business name resolution bug is FIXED. BUG DESCRIPTION: Warm Pipeline (/business/referrals) was showing 'No referrals yet' for Scalis workspace even though matching referral records existed in Airtable Circles table (Business_Name='Scalis'). Root cause was a stale Business table record (Business Name='Www', Business Domain='www.scalis.ai') incorrectly matching email domain lookup, resolving business identity to 'Www' instead of 'Scalis' on read path, while write path correctly used 'Scalis'. FIX IMPLEMENTED: (1) Added _normalize_domain() function (airtable_client.py lines 173-178) to normalize domains by removing http://, https://, trailing slashes, and www. prefix. (2) Updated get_business_name_by_email_domain() (lines 181-205) to use _normalize_domain() for both email domain and Business Domain from Airtable, prioritizing exact matches over subdomain matches. (3) Deleted bad Business record from Airtable. COMPREHENSIVE TEST RESULTS: ✅ Login successful (dcameron@payrewards.com). ✅ Uploaded test transcript (Nimbus Corp VP of Sales demo). ✅ Transcript analyzed successfully. ✅ Navigated to Growth Signals, found conversation, obtained approval link (/t/6ae5ce8c9fb2). ✅ Approved testimonial successfully. ✅ Submitted referral: Sarah Johnson, sarah.johnson@techstartup.com, TechStartup Inc. ✅✅✅ CRITICAL SUCCESS: Navigated to Warm Pipeline (/business/referrals) - Sarah Johnson APPEARS in Active warm leads table! ✅ Lead details: Name='Sarah Johnson', Company='TECHSTARTUP INC', Status='Researching...', Referred on='Jul 27 8:21 PM', Referrer='Unknown'. ✅ Warm Pipeline shows 2 active leads (Sarah Johnson + Jane Doe from previous test). ✅ NO empty state message - referrals are correctly appearing. ✅ No console errors or network 4xx/5xx errors detected. VERIFICATION: Business name resolution between write path (POST /api/public/testimonial/{shareId}/referrals) and read path (GET /api/warm-leads) is now CONSISTENT. The www. prefix normalization and exact match prioritization ensure correct business name resolution. CONCLUSION: Bug is FULLY FIXED and PRODUCTION-READY. Referrals submitted through public testimonial pages now correctly appear in Warm Pipeline for the correct business workspace."

##           comment: "✅✅✅ NAVIGATION BUG FIX VERIFIED (2026-07-27 20:37) ✅✅✅: Comprehensive testing confirms the Warm Pipeline navigation redirect loop is FIXED. BUG DESCRIPTION: When navigating to Warm Pipeline page (/business/referrals), the app would immediately redirect back to Sources page (/business/import). Root cause: DashboardLayout.jsx had a useEffect with loc.pathname in dependency array that re-ran GET /api/sources and force-redirected to /business/import EVERY time the user navigated, if zero sources were returned for their business. This created a redirect loop for any page not in the permitted paths list. FIX IMPLEMENTED: Added zeroStateChecked ref guard (line 67) to ensure the zero-source check runs only ONCE per login session instead of on every navigation. The useEffect (lines 78-93) now checks !zeroStateChecked.current before running, sets it to true immediately, then performs the sources check. This prevents re-runs on subsequent navigations. COMPREHENSIVE TEST RESULTS (dcameron@payrewards.com / P@yRew@rds123): ✅ TEST 1 - Login: Successful authentication. ✅ TEST 2 - Direct Navigation: Navigated to /business/referrals, page loaded and STAYED on Warm Pipeline (no redirect). Verified with 5-second wait - URL remained /business/referrals. ✅ TEST 3 - Cross-Navigation: Navigated to Growth Signals (/business/conversations) and back to Warm Pipeline - NO redirect occurred. ✅ TEST 4 - Multiple Navigations: Navigated to Growth Amplification (/business/social) and back to Warm Pipeline - NO redirect occurred. ✅ TEST 5 - Hard Refresh: Performed hard refresh on /business/referrals - page stayed on Warm Pipeline. API MONITORING: GET /api/sources called only ONCE on initial navigation (as expected). On subsequent returns to Warm Pipeline: 0 calls to /api/sources (ref guard working correctly). PAGE VERIFICATION: Warm Pipeline page rendered correctly showing 2 active warm leads (Sarah Johnson, Jane Doe) with full data. No console errors related to navigation. No network 4xx/5xx errors. CONCLUSION: Bug is FULLY FIXED and PRODUCTION-READY. Users can now navigate to Warm Pipeline and stay there without being redirected to Sources page. The ref guard successfully prevents the zero-source check from running on every navigation."
